description: Initialize zone variables. Values that can be set include extra, state, stress, stress-principal.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: extra variable for array index i

keywords.name: state
keywords.description: The plasticity indicators for tetrahedrons are set to i . Normally the value of i used is 0 in order to reset the failure indicators.

keywords.name: stress
keywords.description: Initialize the full stress tensor (xx yy zz xy xz yz). First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration.

keywords.name: stress-principal
keywords.syntax: stress-principal [{direction-intermediate <v> [zoneinitializeoptions] | direction-maximum <v> [zoneinitializeoptions] | direction-minimum <v> [zoneinitializeoptions] | intermediate <f> [zoneinitializeoptions] | maximum <f> [zoneinitializeoptions] | minimum <f> [zoneinitializeoptions]} ...]
keywords.description: Initialize stresses via principal values and directions. First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration. Options: direction-intermediate <v>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Direction of intermediate principal stress.; direction-maximum <v>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Direction of maximum principal stress.; direction-minimum <v>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Direction of minimum principal stress.; intermediate <f>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Intermediate principal stress magnitude.; maximum <f>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Maximum (most postitive) principal stress.; minimum <f>[zoneinitializeoptions]: Minimum (most negative) principal stress.

keywords.name: state
keywords.description: The plasticity indicators for tetrahedrons are set to i . Normally the value of i used is 0 in order to reset the failure indicators.

keywords.name: stress
keywords.syntax: stress [{xx <f> | xy <f> | xz <f> | yy <f> | yz <f> | zz <f>} ...]
keywords.description: Initialize the full stress tensor (xx yy zz xy xz yz). First-slot keyword verified by live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumeration. Options: xx <f>: xx -component of stress; xy <f>: xy -component of stress; xz <f>: xz -component of stress; yy <f>: yy -component of stress; yz <f>: yz -component of stress; zz <f>: zz -component of stress
